nodes.name: When Called By Another Workflow
nodes.notes: Expects per item: postId, postText, hashtags, storyTopic, vertical, sourceLink, imageUrl. Returns: imageUrl, imageSource, altText.

nodes.name: TEST Webhook
nodes.notes: For testing the resolver end to end.

nodes.name: Choose Image Strategy
nodes.notes: Decides which rung applies and renders the branded SVG card. Brand colours at the top.

nodes.name: Generate AI Image
nodes.notes: Raw HTTP, not the LangChain OpenAI node - that node cannot execute on this n8n instance. Only reached when a post has no arrow facts.

nodes.name: AI Image To Upload Payload
nodes.notes: alwaysOutputData must stay OFF. With it on, an empty result injected a blank item that hit Cloudinary with no file, which made Upload and Finalize run a second time and overwrite the good results.

nodes.name: Upload To Cloudinary
nodes.notes: public_id is the Post_ID, so re-runs overwrite rather than duplicate.

nodes.name: Finalize Result
nodes.notes: One row per post. An image failure degrades to text-only, never blocks the post.
